models.changes: Upstream: mesh simplification and meshopt compression. Maloni: decompression, quantized position normalization, coordinate rotation, uniform scaling, OBJ export, vertex-color palette baking and material conversion. Geometry is a visual reference, not certified manufacturer CAD. Further Maloni presentation changes: color-based surface separation, paint/glass/chrome/rubber materials and paint recoloring (teal CHERY, silver Volvo, dark red BMW). Original GLB bytes unchanged.
